data.interpretation: Cloud cover blinds the optical tracking a range relies on, and surface wind is a hard launch constraint. A window graded unfavourable that then passes with nothing observed is better read as a weather scrub than a cancellation. Thresholds are Sentiry's own heuristics, not published range limits, and this feed carries no weight in the fused score.
